title: AffineEtaleCoveringEventually
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed preorder, D : I^op → Scheme a diagram of qcqs schemes with affine transitions, and c a limiting cone. Let U_ij and v_i be functors between the full affine étale categories [def-weil-pbc-full-affine-etale-site], with natural first projections p_ij and q_i whose squares over D_ji and c_i are pullbacks [def-pc-fibre-product]. Given a stage i, n : N, objects Ai and Bi_a indexed by Fin n, and arrows fi_a : Bi_a → Ai, if the finite family v_i(fi_a) covers v_i(Ai), then there exist j ≥ i and h : i ≤ j such that U_ij(fi_a) covers U_ij(Ai). Empty families are included.

proof.text: Let E be the finite union of the stage arrows images. The arrows are étale between affine schemes, so their images are constructible by Chevalley. Naturality of q and the target q-pullback isomorphism show the canonical limit pullback projection has image in E.

Whisker the canonical base-change diagram by the equivalence from the directed upper tail to Over (op i). Apply the limit-contained-in-constructible theorem to the pullback of E at its initial stage. Projection identities yield a later stage whose projection to Ai has image in E.

The p-pullback isomorphism transfers containment to the chosen U-image. Naturality and pullback cancellation give a pullback square for each arrow. Lift points through it to prove joint surjectivity. With n = 0, E is empty, forcing the target empty.

proof_origin.place: Adaptation of 0EYL to chosen functors; source read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0EYL and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07RR on 2026-10-12
